name: com.yohash.propulsion.entities
description: Stable PD control for Unity ECS physics bodies, built on Propulsion Core. Components drive a body's position and rotation towards targets with a physically parameterized response (frequency in Hz, damping ratio), applied as forces that combine with every other force in the scene. Backends compile only when their physics package is installed: ECSPhysics2D (com.ecsphysics2d.core) for 2D. Install com.yohash.propulsion.core first.

samples.description: Three ECSPhysics2D boxes under gravity driven by PD forces while other forces act on them: one holds its pose and recovers from periodic kicks, one follows a circling target with derived target velocities, and one holds against a constant wind while snapping its heading. Requires com.ecsphysics2d.core.
